Class Stylesheet

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.css.model.Stylesheet
public final class Stylesheet extends Object
Represents a parsed CSS stylesheet.

Contains CSS variables and rules that can be applied to elements.

    • merge

      public Stylesheet merge(Stylesheet other)
      Merges another stylesheet into this one.

      Variables from the other stylesheet override this one's variables. Rules from the other stylesheet are appended after this one's rules.

      Parameters:
      other - the stylesheet to merge
      Returns:
      a new merged stylesheet
